data.name: Mahipatsinh
data.long_meaning: Mahipatsinh is a compound name derived from Mahipat and Sinh. Mahipat means 'Lord' or 'God' and Sinh means 'Lion'. Thus, Mahipatsinh can be interpreted as 'Lord of the Battlefield' or 'God of the Lions'. This name is often given to a son in the hope that he will be brave, strong, and victorious like a lion.

in_sanskrit.name: महीपत्सिंह
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has the power over all the gods and the universe. The king of all beings. (मही - Mahī, meaning 'earth' or 'universe'; पति - Patī, meaning 'lord' or 'master'; सिंह - Siṃha, meaning 'lion')

in_hindi.name: महिपत्सिंह
in_hindi.long_meaning: The supreme lord. (महीपती - Mahipatī, meaning 'supreme lord')

in_tamil.name: மகிபத்சிங்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who has the power over all beings and the universe. (மகி - Makī, meaning 'all'; பத்சி - Patsi, meaning 'power'; ங் - ṅ, a consonant used as a suffix to denote masculine gender)

The name also reflects the traditional Hindu valor and respect for strength and courage, which are considered noble qualities.

The name Mahipatsinh is often used as a reminder to seek refuge in the divine during challenging times and to remain steadfast in one's faith.
